title: Consultor Especialista em Processos II | Rio de Janeiro - Híbrido
description: Consultor Especialista em Processos II | Rio de Janeiro - Híbrido Brazil - Rio de Janeiro O profissional será responsável pela análise crítica e pela gestão de planos de ação, além de propor soluções para problemas relacionados aos projetos da Gerência Executiva. Atuação na área de gestão e processos, com foco no suporte e execução de tarefas operacionais de complexidade média. Será responsável pela análise estruturada de dados e informações, consolidada de levantamentos, além de apoiar e eventualmente orientar a realização das atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções e implementação de melhorias na gestão da rotina e dos processos da Gerência Executiva. Suporte na estruturação de documentos, relatórios e apresentações; validação, análise e proposição de conteúdos; e desenvolvimento de soluções de média complexidade no atendimento das demandas na área (subeixo) em que atua. O escopo de atividades envolve pesquisas (levantamento, estruturação e consolidação de dados), análise crítica de informações consolidadas, planejamento, estruturação e execução de relatórios e apresentações, preparação de reuniões, eventos (palestras, treinamentos, workshops, reuniões gerenciais, etc.), geração de conteúdos e desenvolvimento de soluções para as demandas de trabalho, garantindo excelência, alta qualidade, desempenho e atendimento tempestivo às demandas junto às gerências que prestarão serviço. Pesquisar, estruturar e consolidar informações para a composição de documentos, relatórios e pareceres relacionados à gestão das rotinas e dos processos, promovendo a consolidação, revisão e disponibilização para a avaliação e validação final dos profissionais que atuam nas demandas de complexidade alta e gestor líder da CONTRATADA, além de gestores e especialistas da PETROBRAS. Será também responsável pela estruturação do material das RACs (Reuniões de Análise Crítica) e pela gestão e controle dos indicadores de desempenho e metas das gerências, com geração de alertas, levantamento do histórico e comportamento dos indicadores e metas, realização de análise crítica e estruturação da visão prospectiva e evolutiva dos resultados ao longo do ano. Deverão propor planos de ação em caso de desvios ou riscos de cumprimento de metas, cujo conteúdo e formatação deverão ser previamente avaliados e validados pelo gestor líder, antes de serem apresentados aos gestores e especialistas da PETROBRAS nos respectivos RACs de resultados gerenciais. Prestar suporte direto na estruturação e desenvolvimento das propostas de indicadores de desempenho, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao levantamento de insumos, alimentação de sistemas, análises de resultados, elaboração de materiais para validação gerencial e revisões de insumos. Os processos, atividades e tarefas atreladas a este quadrante de prestação de serviços são de complexidade média e exigem conhecimento específico, capacitação e experiência. Envolvem conteúdo analítico para estruturação, gestão e controle de planos de ação no tratamento de demandas específicas na área/eixo de atuação, com vistas de garantir resultados para a respectiva gestão que atuar. Deverá também controlar processos e atividades tais como: apuração de resultados de indicadores, identificação de anomalias e desvios de processos, organização de RACs gerenciais, preparação de apresentações e relatórios para apoio gerencial, controle do avanço de tarefas dos Planos de Ação e Iniciativas Estratégicas, mapeamento e desenho de fluxos de processos, entre outras atribuições correlatas. Graduação: Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Direito, Economia, Análise de Tecnologia da Informação, Administrador de Tecnologia da Informação ou outras áreas correlatas à especialidade. Experiência de atuação nas seguintes especialidades: Gestão Empresarial, Gestão Estratégica, Gestão por Resultados, Gestão Ágil, Gestão de Processos ou outras áreas correlatas à especialidade. Boa comunicação interpessoal e escrita, com habilidade para facilitar interações entre áreas diversas. Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e entrega de soluções. Domínio das ferramentas: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word e MS Project. Experiência de atuação na área. Regime Hibrído, com disponibilidade para atuar no Rio de Janeiro 3 dias por semana. This is a permanent, full-time position based 100% on-site in Rio de Janeiro city. Job Responsibilities Design, test, and integrate analog and digital printed circuit boards (PCBs) for downhole tools used in harsh operational environments. Work with international development teams to ensure design consistency and integration. Conduct simulation and modeling of hardware designs using tools such as LTSPICE or PSPICE. Develop PCB layouts using CAD tools such as PADS or Altium Designer. Perform hands‑on testing and validation using laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, signal generators, network analyzers, and data acquisition systems. Utilize LabVIEW or MATLAB to develop interfaces for controlling test setups and collecting measurement data. Contribute to technical documentation and participate in internal design reviews. Actively participate in innovation and continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering group. Job Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field (Master’s or Ph.D. is a plus). Proven experience in developing complex embedded hardware systems for harsh environments. Solid understanding of analog and digital system design: filters, amplifiers, data converters, memory interfaces, and communication protocols. Proficiency in electronic simulation tools and laboratory instrumentation. Experience with LabVIEW and/or MATLAB for data acquisition and system control. Strong problem‑solving skills, self‑motivation, and a collaborative mindset. Previous experience in R&D environments is highly desirable. Native portuguese and Fluent or Advanced English is required. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: REMOTE - Senior Data Engineer (SQL DBA)
description: Job Description M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives. Primary DBA Responsibilities Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability. Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency. Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning. Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing. Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance. Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards. Team Responsibilities Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs. Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks. Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives. Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting. Qualifications Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery). Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams. Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives. Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail. AI and Automation Expectations Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality. Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation. Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification. Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability. Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data. Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability). Engagement Model This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need. We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership. Additional Information We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours. We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English. M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Especialista em Operações Comerciais
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) . No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de ESPECIALISTA EM OPERAÇÕES COMERCIAIS abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso: Sua missão Operar e otimizar o e-commerce (cadastro de produtos, preços e acompanhamento de pedidos). Acompanhar pedidos e garantir fluxo correto até a entrega ao cliente. Atuar junto à logística para melhorar prazos, custos e nível de serviço. Apoiar na contratação e gestão de transportadoras e fornecedores. Contribuir na organização do centro de distribuição e fluxo de pedidos. Aplicar políticas comerciais considerando impostos e benefícios fiscais. Planejar vendas e alinhar demanda com estoque. Gerenciar mix de produtos e giro de estoque. Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. description: Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores. Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho. Suas principais atividades serão: Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada; Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento; Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica; Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações; Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações; Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica; Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia; Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica; Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica; Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória; Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado; Manter sala de imobilização organizada; Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade; Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual; Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados; Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes; Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento; Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa; Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente; Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação; Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade; Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho. Esperamos que você tenha: Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica. Registro no conselho de Classe. Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses. Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos. Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.**The Role**Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. This is one of the things Kyndryls love about working here. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.**Who You Are**You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Country Lead, Brazil
description: Overview Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant. Samba is entering the Brazilian market, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial, multi-disciplinary consultant to lead the charge on the ground. This is a true 0-to-1 opportunity: you won’t inherit a playbook — you’ll write it. You’ll combine commercial acumen, business development instincts, and technical fluency to establish Samba\'s presence, build partnerships, drive initial revenue, and shape go-to-market products tailored to local market conditions and regulatory requirements. This role sits at the intersection of commercial partnerships, business development, solutions engineering, and market strategy. We need someone who can pitch to senior brand and agency contacts in the morning, troubleshoot data integrations in the afternoon, and brief our product team on local market requirements in the evening. If you thrive in ambiguity, build structure where none exists, and are energized by the prospect of building a new market from scratch — this role is for you. This is a contract / consultant engagement based in São Paulo. The initial engagement period will be defined based on mutual alignment, with the potential for extension or conversion based on market traction and business needs. Travel within Brazil is expected; occasional travel to Samba offices in the US or other international locations may be required. What You'll Do Own the commercial strategy for Brazil: identify target accounts, build pipeline, and close initial deals across agencies, advertisers, and media companies. Take a consultative approach to sales — educate the market on Samba\'s data, measurement, and audience solutions while adapting value propositions to local needs. Develop and execute account plans for key prospects, manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, and maintain accurate forecasting. Identify, evaluate, and negotiate strategic partnerships with local broadcasters, OEMs, data providers, platforms, and technology partners critical to Samba\'s Brazil infrastructure. Map the Brazilian media, advertising, and data ecosystem — understand who the key players are, where the opportunities lie, and what partnerships unlock scale. Serve as the technical point of contact for prospects and partners — scope integrations, troubleshoot implementation questions, and translate Samba\'s product capabilities into client-specific solutions. Provide technical pre-sales support: run product demos, respond to RFIs/RFPs, and build proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate value. Develop a comprehensive Brazil market entry strategy encompassing regulatory landscape, competitive positioning, data privacy compliance (LGPD), partnership requirements, and revenue projections. Build the operational foundation for Samba\'s Brazil presence — define processes, reporting cadences, and success metrics. Provide regular market updates and strategic recommendations to Samba\'s international and executive leadership. Who You Are Entrepreneurial builder with 10+ years of commercial experience in ad tech, media, data, or DaaS/SaaS — with a proven track record of launching products, entering new markets, and closing deals in Brazil or broader Latin America. Commercially sharp and strategically minded: you\'ve built pipelines, closed deals, and thought beyond quota to build something new, whether through a consulting, market entry, or strategic commercial background. Technically fluent: you understand APIs, data integrations, programmatic ecosystems, and measurement methodologies well enough to hold your own in technical conversations and troubleshoot client implementations. Deeply networked across the Brazilian ecosystem: established relationships with agencies, broadcasters, platforms, and advertisers, including major holding companies such as Publicis, WPP, Omnicom, Dentsu, Havas, and IPG. Knowledgeable about the Brazilian media and data landscape: including the television ecosystem (Globo, SBT, Record, RedeTV!, pay TV, OTT/streaming, ACR/smart TV), audience data, cross-screen measurement, and data privacy regulations (LGPD). Trilingual: native or professional fluency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish is required. Self-directed and cross-functional: you operate with significant autonomy, set your own priorities, and collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, legal, and marketing, often across time zones. Comfortable at the executive level: confident presenting to C-suite buyers and navigating complex, enterprise-level negotiations. MBA or equivalent advanced degree from a top-tier program is preferred. Samba is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We strive to empower connection with one another, reflect the communities we serve, and tackle meaningful projects that make a real impact. Samba may collect personal information directly from you, as a job applicant, and may also receive personal information from third parties, for example, in connection with a background, employment or reference check, in accordance with applicable law. For further details, please see Samba\'s Applicant Privacy Policy. For residents of the EU, Samba Inc. is the data controller. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description: Position Summary The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders. Main Duties & Responsibilities Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification. Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls. Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks. Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting. Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions. Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios. Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership. Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards. Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost). Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management. Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting. Minimum Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience. Preferred Education & Experience (optional) Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent). Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset. Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. title: [Banco de Talentos] Coordenador(a) de Programas (RJ)

title: Rigless Operations Foreman- Relocate to Saudi Arabia
description: Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia. Overview We are seeking a Rigless Operations Foreman to join Unconventional Resources Completion Operations Division under the Completion Operations Department URCOD. The UR Completion Operation Division is responsible for executing required Rigless operations in unconventional fields. The support includes supervising rigless sites with up to 200 service contractors to execute a variety of rigless operations including multistage hydraulic fracture, coiled tubing operations, well testing operations, while maintaining safety and compliance in accordance with industry standards and company policies. Your primary role is to lead and supervise all rigless well intervention operations (wireline, slickline, coiled tubing and snubbing) including but not limited to plug and perf frac operations, post- frac wellbore coiled tubing cleanout, through tubing fishing and milling operations, in addition to maintaining compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry standards, enforcing safe work practices and conducting on job safety meetings. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Interface directly with engineers, service company personnel, and management to ensure alignment on operational objectives and risk mitigation. Conduct site inspections, job observations, and equipment audits to ensure equipment and personnel are operating within required standards. Ensure well barrier integrity and adherence to well control requirements during all intervention activities. Participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned initiatives to drive continuous improvement. Contribute to the growth and capability of junior team members. Qualifications Technical Diploma or Bachelor's degree in relevant fields, such as petroleum technology or mechanical engineering from a recognized and approved program. 10-15 years’ experience in rigless well intervention operations that includes planning and execution of stimulation, wireline, slickline, coiled tubing and flowback operation in critical sour gas and preferably unconventional operational environment. Experience in unconventional resources or HPHT, tight gas & oil well with a very good understanding of well intervention and stimulation operation and its impact on well completion. Proven record in running all types intervention operations required in unconventional wells: Coiled tubing, Wireline, slick line, Hydraulic fracturing, flow back operations. Familiar with wellhead and downhole completion design, optimization, and troubleshooting. Extensive knowledge of industry regulations, safety practices and standards related to surface and downhole equipment selection. Experience in optimization of surface well intervention operation using latest new technologies and best practices. Able to complete an investigation when issues occur and finalize root cause analysis. Experience in performance optimization, cost control, and operational efficiency improvements in unconventional well environments. Strong expertise in unconventional wells operation, well performance analysis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Consultor de Negócios (Ekotruck)
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR) . No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! title: Analista Operações Logísticas, AMXL
description: Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejan itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logística do Brasil está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time que gerencia as operações de Extra Large (AMXL). Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back. Essa pessoa atuará na gestão e execução tática das rotinas nas estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco para atuar como guardião dos SOPs padrões do node. Key job responsibilities Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias; Orientar e liderar plano de ação com parceiros em busca da excelência operacional; Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos; Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas; Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos; Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações; Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais. A day in the life Seu dia é dedicado a monitorar a Torre de Controle e executar rotinas diárias no node para entregas de produtos Pesados/Grandes (Heavy/Bulky). Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. With a strong entrepreneurial mindset, this individual will spend the majority of their time in-market, working hands‑on to elevate execution. They will lead the adoption of the AVQPAP model (Availability, Visibility, Quality, Price, Activation, Promotion) to bring the Picture of Success to life. Partnering closely with distributor sales teams and key customers, they will identify opportunities, close executional gaps, and build long‑term, value‑driven relationships across São Paulo and the broader Southeast region. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Field Execution & Market Presence Be present in the market on a daily basis, visiting On Trade, Off Trade and Key Accounts, ensuring the correct execution of Zamora’s brands. Accompany the distributor's team in top accounts to guarantee strategic alignment. Identify execution gaps and immediately work with distributors and outlets to correct them. Ensure all points of sale are aligned with Zamora’s brand positioning and premium image. Distributor & Sales Team Development Work hand in hand with distributor sales teams, acting as a field coach and execution driver to generate sell out. Support sales reps during visits, helping them to sell, place, activate and upgrade Zamora brands. Train distributor and customers’ sales forces on ZC Brands (brand building and story‑selling) Trade Marketing & Activation Design and execute point‑of‑sale activation plans tailored to Rio’s On & Off Trade reality. Implement national and regional brand programs in the field, ensuring perfect execution at store level. Lead tastings, bartender activations, menu placements, cocktail programs and in‑store promotions. Be responsible for the quality of execution of key platforms like L43 Puro, Carajillo and Limão. Market Intelligence & Opportunity Detection Act as Zamora’s market radar in Rio. Identify trends, new hot spots, key bartenders, emerging venues and new retail opportunities. Monitor competitors’ activities, pricing, promotions and visibility. Provide regular feedback to the Area Director and Marketing Team with actionable insights. Relationship Building Build strong and trusted relationships with: Distributor management and sales teams Bartenders, bar managers, store owners and buyers Key influencers Become a recognized Zamora representative in the Rio trade. Develop mid- and long‑term partnerships that secure Zamora’s presence in priority accounts. Reporting & Performance Tracking KPIs will be measured in 4 pillars: Business (eg. volume sold on On trade Channel) Commercial Execution (# stores with perfect execution) Promotion (eg, number of trainings) Digital (Eg. reports/ community built) Provide structured reports with photos, insights and recommendations. Help to ensure activities and investments are properly documented and evaluated. REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in Trade Marketing, Brand Activation, Sales or Brand Ambassador roles, ideally in the alcoholic beverages industry. Having worked with distributors is a plus Deep understanding of On-Trade and Off-Trade dynamics in Rio, with a strong “in‑market” mindset and passion for being close to the consumer (bars, restaurants, clubs, and retail). Good understanding of On Trade & Off Trade dynamics in Rio. Strong ability to execute and drive others to execute. Proven ability to execute with excellence and influence others to deliver against high standards in the field. Strong relationship‑building skills, with the ability to engage and partner effectively with distributor sales teams, bartenders, and retail customers. Analytical and action‑oriented mindset, capable of translating field insights into clear, impactful actions. Highly organized, disciplined, and results‑driven, with strong attention to execution quality. Naturally curious and connected to cultural trends (music, nightlife, gastronomy, fashion), with the ability to anticipate emerging opportunities in the market. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools. Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus. Willingness to travel extensively within São Paulo state and work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends. This role is a key pillar in Zamora’s ambition to build a best‑in‑class execution model in Brazil—ensuring our brands are visible, desired, and flawlessly brought to life at every relevant point of sale in Rio. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast‑paced and evolving environment. Experience managing complex internal and external stakeholder relationships, including at senior level. Demonstrated ability to work cross‑functionally, building strong relationships and aligning diverse teams towards a shared objective. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to navigate discussions, resolve issues and drive decisions in a constructive and controlled manner. High level of adaptability and resilience, with the ability to respond to changing priorities, evolving plans and a dynamic operating environment. Comfortable working across time zones and flexible working hours, with willingness to travel extensively as required. A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas. Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões (R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga para projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, a ser alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento). O programa Respeito dá o Tom nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança. title: MEC NICO DE MANUTENÇÃO - SEGMENTO GLP
description: Missão do Cargo Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em equipamentos industriais da operação de GLP, assegurando o funcionamento adequado dos ativos, a segurança operacional, a confiabilidade dos equipamentos e a continuidade das operações da planta. Apoiar as rotinas operacionais da planta, contribuindo para a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e eficiência dos equipamentos. Preencher relatórios de manutenção, ordens de serviço e registros de inspeção conforme procedimentos internos. Pré-requisitos obrigatórios Ensino médio completo; Curso técnico em Mecânica, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas. Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em manutenção industrial. Conhecimento em manutenção de bombas, compressores, sistemas de tubulação e leitura de desenho técnico. Conhecimento em instrumentos de medição mecânica. Conhecimento das normas NR-13 e NR-20. Competências Comportamentais Organização e disciplina operacional. Atenção aos detalhes e foco em segurança. Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade. Trabalho em equipe. Capacidade analítica para solução de problemas. Comprometimento com resultados e qualidade. Diferenciais Experiência no segmento de GLP, combustíveis, indústria química ou petroquímica. Conhecimento em manutenção preditiva. Vivência em ambiente industrial de risco. Cursos complementares em segurança industrial e manutenção mecânica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Record all relevant operational information (including but not limited to tool string and subsea equipment data, dimensions, hanging weights, overpulls etc.). They will ensure that this data is readily available in the doghouse throughout the project as required and officially recorded in their daily operational log. Be competent to operate the MPT and associated MPT systems. Directly supervise & record the opening and closing of the Intervention System and Subsea Tree. Ensure, on an ongoing basis, that all parties under their supervision have clear and effective lines of communication as required, and will ensure that operations do not commence until this is in place and confirmed. title: Senior Staff Engineer - DevOps
description: Job Description Job Summary: We are seeking a skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, containerization, and cloud-native scaling solutions. This role involves working closely with development, platform, and security teams to streamline software delivery and improve operational excellence. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS. Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads. Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins. Manage source code repositories and branching strategies using Git. Automate operational tasks through Bash/Shell scripting. Package, deploy, and manage Kubernetes applications using Helm. Build, optimize, and maintain Docker images and container runtimes. Implement and manage autoscaling solutions using Karpenter and KEDA. Design and support event-driven architectures leveraging messaging systems such as Amazon SQS and RabbitMQ. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure platform reliability. Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment processes, application performance, and operational efficiency. Implement security best practices across cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows. Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Required Qualifications Experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or related roles. Strong hands‑on experience with AWS services and cloud‑native architectures. Expertise in Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting. Proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins. Strong understanding of Git workflows and version control best practices. Proficiency in Bash/Shell scripting for automation. Experience with Helm for Kubernetes application deployment. Strong knowledge of Docker and containerization technologies. Experience implementing workload scaling solutions using Karpenter and KEDA. Hands‑on experience with messaging and queueing systems such as Amazon SQS and RabbitMQ. Strong understanding of networking, security, monitoring, and observability concepts. Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem‑solving skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience implementing GitOps practices using Argo CD. Knowledge of AWS CloudFront and content delivery network (CDN) architectures. Familiarity with application development and deployment for Node.js, Next.js, and FastAPI (Python). Experience with microservices and API‑driven architectures. Exposure to observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. Knowledge of security scanning, compliance automation, and platform governance. Qualifications Must have Skills: DevOps - AWS (Strong), Kubernetes (Strong), Terraform (Strong), CI/CD (Github actions). Good To Have Skills: Python (Strong). #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding, and non‑competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Oversee the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during the planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborate with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensure that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Work closely with the Non‑Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Serve as the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversee contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constantly monitor the budgetary impact of dressing operations and report updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Provide strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offer expertise when required. Adhere to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Maintain daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaise with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Present to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attend department‑specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Input into the site‑specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Act as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participate in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assist with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensure the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribute to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Possibly relocate to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games, etc., or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑faceted events and projects. Experience managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) in Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs, as the role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems. Will attend site visits and be away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Digital Product Manager
description: Digital Product Manager Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first‑party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament‑time digital operations, delivering high‑traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross‑functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Provide clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross‑functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer‑first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI‑driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data‑driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g., Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g., PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end‑to‑end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct‑to‑consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short‑term opportunities. Competencies: Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data‑driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology: Strong knowledge of digital direct‑to‑consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry‑standard solutions, e.g., Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements: Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Agente Educativo Junior – Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio. Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Agente Educativo Jr. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Agente Educativo Jr será responsável por atuar no apoio às exposições e atividades do Centro Cultural Light, assistência e orientação ao público, apoio às atividades educativas, recreativas, imersivas e de lazer, bem como o apoio operacional às atividades programadas pela equipe educativa. Apoiar a recepção, orientação e organização do fluxo de visitantes às exposições e espaços museológicos do Centro Cultural Light; Auxiliar visitantes com necessidades especiais, garantindo acessibilidade adequada e uma experiência inclusiva; Orientar o público quanto às regras de visitação, conservação dos espaços e uso adequado dos equipamentos; Apoiar a execução de atividades recreativas, imersivas e lúdicas programadas pelo Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Educacional Light; Fornecer apoio logístico a atividades educativas, escritórios, visitas mediadas e atividades especiais; Apoiar a montagem, organização e desmontagem de materiais utilizados nas atividades; Contribuir para a manutenção do espaço expositivo, garantindo condições adequadas para a preservação de dois ambientes; Zelar pela correta utilização dos espaços de exposição e pela qualidade da experiência do visitante; Colaborar com a equipe do Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Light, garantindo apoio, segurança e organização durante esses anos; Elaborar relatórios diários das atividades realizadas.
